== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns James Glasgow, master of the Prosperity of Irvine. James Glasgow is named in the Greenock arrival list headed “Greenock, August 12”: “The Prosperity of Irvine, James Glasgow, from Northcopen.” The item was published in The Caledonian Mercury on 18 August 1740, page 3.<ref>The Caledonian Mercury, 18 August 1740, page 3, Greenock shipping list; [https://www.newspapers.com/image/394559372/ record].</ref> The ship–homeport–master–origin format supports reading James as the shipmaster. No age, relatives or personal residence are stated. Irvine is the ship’s homeport and Greenock the reporting locality; neither proves James’s birthplace. Northcopen is retained without an unverified modern-place identification. The identification remains uncertain.
